name: bestprice
description: End-to-end test automation framework for bestprice.com.ua built with TypeScript and Playwright.

scripts.docker:quality: docker run --rm --init bestprice-tests npm run quality
scripts.docker:smoke: docker run --rm --init --ipc=host bestprice-tests npm run test:smoke
scripts.quality: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:integration:stage: dotenv -e .env.stage -- env TEST_ENV=stage playwright test tests/integration
scripts.test:integration:prod: dotenv -e .env.prod -- env TEST_ENV=prod playwright test tests/integration
scripts.test:e2e:stage: dotenv -e .env.stage -- env TEST_ENV=stage playwright test tests/e2e
scripts.test:e2e:prod: dotenv -e .env.prod -- env TEST_ENV=prod playwright test tests/e2e
scripts.test:header:stage: dotenv -e .env.stage -- env TEST_ENV=stage playwright test tests/header
scripts.test:header:prod: dotenv -e .env.prod -- env TEST_ENV=prod playwright test tests/header
scripts.test:sitemap:stage: dotenv -e .env.stage -- env TEST_ENV=stage playwright test tests/e2e/sitemap.spec.ts
scripts.test:sitemap:prod: dotenv -e .env.prod -- env TEST_ENV=prod playwright test tests/e2e/sitemap.spec.ts
scripts.test:smoke: playwright test tests/header && playwright test tests/e2e/sitemap.spec.ts && playwright test tests/e2e/crawl.smoke.spec.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:header
scripts.test:allure: npm run allure:clean && npm run test:allure:unit && npm run test:allure:integration && npm run test:allure:e2e && npm run test:allure:header && npm run allure:generate:unit && npm run allure:generate:e2e
